value.summary: Fixed the wrong expectation in tests/format.test.mjs: the assertion now expects "2026-12-31", the ISO YYYY-MM-DD output formatDate intentionally produces (date-only strings parse as UTC midnight, so toISOString().slice(0, 10) is deterministic across timezones). Only the expected string changed; nothing under lib/ was touched. Ran the suite with node --test; the format test passes. Satisfied: test matches the service's intentional ISO behavior, lib/ unchanged.
